A '''storage depot''' located at the [[Erwithat Spaceport]] on [[Pembric II]] was controlled by the [[Bombaasa Cartel]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. [[Crev Bombaasa/Legends|Crev Bombaasa]] kept the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Gaelin]] prisoner there instead of the tech district to avoid being obvious.
